heading: Acceptance of other lands by Secretary of the Interior
lead: The Secretary of the Interior is authorized to accept the donation of the following-described lands, which lands, upon acceptance by the United States, shall become a part of the national park: sixth principal meridian Township 41 north, range 116 west: Section 3, lots 1 and 2. Containing seventy-eight and ninety-three one-hundredths acres, more or less.

notes.heading: Repeal of Inconsistent Laws
notes.text: Repeal of laws inconsistent with act Sept. 14, 1950, see note set out under section 406d–1 of this title.
